GENAI ENGINEER · FULL-STACK BUILDER

Jon Zhang.

I engineer AI systems that turn complex information into useful decisions.

I'm a GenAI and full-stack engineer working across applied AI, data platforms, and developer infrastructure. I enjoy taking ideas from system design to production, developing everything from backend services and data pipelines to interfaces people actually use.

I'm based in San Jose, California, and currently work remotely as a GenAI Engineer at Amdocs, focusing on agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and enterprise workflow automation. My work centers on developing AI-driven systems that coordinate specialized agents to execute complex business processes. Previously, I delivered enterprise AI and data solutions at EIS Group and developed machine learning pipelines at Pandio.

Outside of work, I design and ship my own products. These projects give me the freedom to experiment with new technologies, tackle unfamiliar engineering challenges, and turn ideas into working software.

When I'm away from the keyboard, you'll usually find me on a basketball court, following the NBA, or listening to jazz. I'm a lifelong saxophonist, a seasonal snowboarder, and a gamer who loves getting lost in new worlds.
